limitations: Selected-scenario conformance is not a mechanized implementation refinement proof.
The complete-mediation pair forces one safe actuator trace and one direct-call mutation; it does not establish deployment-wide path coverage, credential isolation, or durable-store correctness.
The end-to-end composed model covers its 28 declared Next actions; formal mutation operators are reported separately and are not runtime transitions.
Declared-action coverage does not prove every runtime parameter, concurrency schedule, deployment, or external-system behavior.
The formal models, adapters, and runtime implementations are maintained by the same team.
Cryptographic primitives, trusted clocks, provider truth, complete mediation, and durable database semantics remain explicit acceptance roots.
